$comment: Single source of truth for the CaveBettor landing-page visual assets. scripts/generate-assets.mjs reads this file, scripts/build-assets.mjs derives WebP + responsive variants, scripts/check-asset-uniqueness.mjs enforces one logical placement per visual.
styleGuide: Premium cinematic sports-intelligence photography, night-time stadium and analytics-desk atmosphere, deep pitch-green and near-black environment, lime (#c9ff4d) and mint (#35e7a1) accent light, shallow depth of field, clean composition with negative space on the left for headlines, Nigerian context where people appear, no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no brand marks.
